title: fin.cap.create_escalation_case
description: Open one escalation case for an investigated transaction. Tenant, principal, epoch and created_by_intent are filled by Noema, never by the caller. Pack data (noema#362): only the fields a caller supplies; additionalProperties false. SYNTHETIC.

transaction_ref.description: The transaction the person refers to (the fin.transaction resolved in the intent slot subject_resource).

reason_code.description: Why the case is opened (a code, not free text).

owner_queue.description: Optional queue; the stand-in's default applies when absent. Routing is allowlisted by the pack.

priority.description: Optional priority; the stand-in's default applies when absent.
